cases.name: NAME HIDDEN
cases.relationship: Boyfriend / domestic partner; Coworker / employee / employer
cases.narrative:
In total, she had been shot at least six times. 

He said he was driving her home when he saw she was receiving text messages from another man asking her to hang out, which upset him and he was dating the other man, but she denied it. He grew angry and...demanded her to tell the truth and threatened to shoot her if she didn’t and told her that if she didn’t admit she was in another relationship, “he would have to hurt her.”

As they were driving, he shot her once in the leg because she “would not admit what she had done." He then continued driving and shot her a second time in the leg. She began crying and asking him to stop, but he continued driving. Officers say he kept shooting at her, striking her at least once as they approached the her house in Phoenix, but he then turned around and drove back to Tempe. As they drove, police say a struggle broke out as she tried to grab the gun from him. He crashed into a curb, and the car stopped on Broadway Road. Investigators say Aguilar then grabbed the gun, got out of the vehicle and shot directly at the victim multiple times. Court documents say as Aguilar saw three police cars driving up to him, he shot himself in the chest.
